description: Content Distribution without a Web ACL
rationale: A CloudFront distribution is reachable from anywhere by design, and it forwards to its origin whatever it does not serve from cache. Without a web ACL nothing inspects those requests before the origin receives them, so the distribution acts as an anonymising layer in front of the application: the origin sees CloudFront addresses, and the account has no record of what was sent. A web ACL in the CLOUDFRONT scope is also where the requests can be refused at the edge, before they cost anything at the origin.
remediation: Associate a WAF web ACL of the CLOUDFRONT scope with the distribution, holding at least the AWS managed baseline rule groups
